state.contractText: This Agreement shall automatically renew for successive one (1) year terms unless either party provides written notice of non-renewal at least sixty (60) days prior to the end of the then-current Term. Notice must be sent to legal@vendor.com or via certified mail to the address set forth above.
state.cancellationEmailText: Hi team, following up on our call — we've decided not to continue our subscription and would like to cancel before it renews. Please confirm this has been processed.

autoRenewal.instructions: Read the contract in state.contractText. Determine whether it contains a clause that automatically renews the agreement unless the customer affirmatively gives notice to prevent renewal.

criteria.true: The contract auto-renews (evergreen/auto-renewal clause) unless notice of non-renewal is given.
criteria.false: The contract does not auto-renew, or renewal requires the customer's affirmative opt-in rather than notice to opt out.

requiredNoticeDays.instructions: Read state.contractText and determine the minimum number of days of advance notice, before the end of the current term, that the customer must give to prevent auto-renewal. Choose the option matching the contract's stated period; choose 'unspecified' if no notice period is stated.

criteria.15: Contract requires at least 15 days notice.
criteria.30: Contract requires at least 30 days notice.
criteria.45: Contract requires at least 45 days notice.
criteria.60: Contract requires at least 60 days notice.
criteria.90: Contract requires at least 90 days notice.
criteria.unspecified: The contract does not state a specific notice period.

noticeMethodCompliant.instructions: Compare any notice-delivery requirements in state.contractText (required recipient/address, written form, delivery channel such as certified mail) to state.cancellationEmailText, which was sent as an email. If the contract states no specific method, treat email as compliant.

criteria.true: The email satisfies the contract's method requirements for cancellation/non-renewal notice, or the contract specifies no particular method.
criteria.false: The contract requires a specific method (e.g. certified mail, a specific address/recipient, a signed form) that the email does not satisfy.

cancellationIntentClear.instructions: Read state.cancellationEmailText. Determine whether it unambiguously communicates the customer's intent to cancel or not renew the contract, as opposed to a general inquiry, complaint, or conditional/ambiguous statement.

criteria.true: The email clearly and unambiguously states intent to cancel or not renew.
criteria.false: The email is ambiguous, conditional, or does not clearly state intent to cancel or not renew.
